sn56.25:1.1: jānato ahaṃ bhikkhave passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi no ajānato apassato.
sn56.25:1.2: kiñca bhikkhave jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn56.25:1.3: idaṃ dukkhanti bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn56.25:1.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato evaṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn56.25:2.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
